pages.title: Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Subaru/VIN Codes
pages.text:
{{Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Warning}}{{clear}} This chart is applicable to Subaru models made for North America. Subaru uses a '''17-character VIN''' format and code for vehicles sold in the United States. These rules also apply to the Saab 9-2X, a badge-engineered Subaru Impreza wagon and to the Scion FR-S/Toyota 86/Toyota GR86, a twin of the Subaru BRZ. For Subaru Uncharted, Solterra, and Trailseeker, see the Toyota VIN page: [[Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Toyota/VIN Codes]]. ==Subaru VIN code== The following sample is the sequence and meaning of each character in the Subaru VIN:
Position Sample Description
1 J [[#Subaru WMIs|World Manufacturer Identifier]]
2 F
3 1
4 C [[#Line types|Line type]]
5 X [[#Body styles|Body style]]
6 8 [[#Engine types|Engine type]]
7 6 [[#Models|Model identifier]]
8 5 [[#Restraint types|Restraint type]]
9 9 [[../../Check digit/]]
10 T [[../../Model year/]]
11 H [[#Plants and transmission types|Plant of manufacture & transmission type]]
12 1 [[#Serial Number|Sequential production number]]
13 0
14 0
15 2
16 1
17 6
The above serial number describes the following vehicle built in Japan by Fuji Heavy Industries:
1996 Subaru Alcyone SVX, 3.3L EG33 engine, AWD 4EAT transmission, manual seat belts
with driver / passenger airbags. The 216th vehicle produced during the 1996 model year.

Honda uses the following VIN formats and codes.  Honda has slightly varied the usage of some positions within the VIN over the years.  Consult the individual sections below for more information.

For Honda Passport ('94-'02) and Acura SLX, see the Isuzu VIN page: [[Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Isuzu/VIN Codes]].

For Honda Prologue & '24 Acura ZDX EV see the GM VIN page: [[Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/GM/VIN Codes]].

===Production sequence number===
Canadian models share same VIN as U.S. except that their sequence numbers start at 800000. It is also important to note that, in the U.S., positions 13-17 must be a number, whereas position 12 may be either a letter or a number.

{{Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Warning}}{{clear}} == Aventador, Revuelto, Huracan & Temerario == Digit 1 = "Z" (Europe) Digit 2 = "H" (Italy) Digit 3 = "W" (Automobili Lamborghini) Digit 4 = Market (C=Canada, E=Europe/Rest of World, U=USA) Digit 5 = Body/Restraint Aventador (C=LP 700-4 Coupe, R=LP 700-4 Roadster, D=LP 720-4 50º Anniversario Coupe, S=LP 720-4 50º Anniversario Roadster, A=Veneno Coupe, B=Veneno Roadster, F=SV LP 750-4 Coupe, T=SV LP 750-4 Roadster, G=S LP 740-4 Coupe, V=S LP 740-4 Roadster, Y=Centenario Coupe, Z=Centenario Roadster, M=SVJ LP 770-4 Coupe, N=SVJ LP 770-4 Roadster, J=Sián FKP 37 Coupe, K=Sián Roadster, P=LP 780-4 Ultimae Coupe, U=LP 780-4 Ultimae Roadster, A='22 Countach LPI 800-4 coupe) All have 6 airbags (front, side, knee) and type 2 active seat belts with pretensioners. Digit 5 = Body/Restraint Revuelto (C=Coupe) All have front, side, side curtain, & knee airbags for driver/passenger and type 2 active seat belts with pretensioners. Digit 5 = Body/Restraint Huracan (C=LP 610-4 Coupe or LP 580-2 Coupe, R=LP 610-4 Spyder or LP 580-2 Spyder, D=LP 640-4 Performante Coupe, S=LP 640-4 Performante Spyder, F=Evo Coupe or Evo RWD Coupe, T=Evo Spyder or Evo RWD Spyder, A=STO Coupe, B=Tecnica Coupe, G=Sterrato Coupe) All have 6 airbags (front, side, knee) and type 2 active seat belts with pretensioners. Digit 5 = Body/Restraint Temerario (C=Coupe) All have front, side, side curtain, & knee airbags for driver/passenger and type 2 active seat belts with pretensioners. Digit 6 = Aventador: Engine (1=6.5L V12 690HP L539 [LP 700-4], 2=6.5L V12 710HP L539 [LP 720-4 50º Anniversario], 3=6.5L V12 740HP L539 [SV LP 750-4, Veneno], 4=6.5L V12 730HP L539 [S LP 740-4], 5=6.5L V12 760HP L541 [Centenario], 6=6.5L V12 760HP L541 [SVJ LP 770-4], 7=6.5L V12 774HP L541 + 34HP electric motor = 808HP Total [Sián FKP 37, Sián Roadster], 8=6.5L V12 769HP L541 [Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae], 9=6.5L V12 769HP L541 + 34HP electric motor = 803HP Total ['22 Countach LPI 800-4]) Digit 6 = Revuelto: Engine (1=6.5L V12 814HP L545 + 295HP front electric motors (made by Yasa) + 148HP rear electric motor (made by Mahle) = 1,001HP Total) Digit 6 = Huracan: Engine/Wheel Drive (1=5.2L V10 602HP CSJ 4WD [LP 610-4], 2=5.2L V10 572HP CSJ 2WD [LP 580-2], 4=5.2L V10 631HP CSJ 4WD [LP 640-4 Performante, LP 640-4 Evo], 5=5.2L V10 602HP CSJ 2WD [LP 610-2 Evo], 6=5.2L V10 631HP CSJ 2WD [Tecnica, STO], 7=5.2L V10 602HP CSJ 4WD [Sterrato]) Digit 6 = Temerario: Engine (1=4.0L (3995 cc) twin-turbo V8 789HP L411 (DZS) + 148HP front electric motors (made by Yasa) + 148HP rear electric motor (made by Yasa) = 907HP Total) Digit 7 = Make: Z=Lamborghini Digit 8 = Line: D=Aventador (includes '22 Countach LPI 800-4), M=Revuelto, F=Huracan (except STO), X=Huracan STO, C=Temerario Digit 9 = North American VIN Check Digit. Must be digits 0-9 or letter X. Digit 10 = Model Year (eg C=2012, L=2020, R=2024, etc.) Digit 11 = Plant (L=Sant'Agata Bolognese - Bologna, Italy) Digit 12 = Serial number prefix "A" (legacy value) Digits 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17 = Serial Number (clarified by digit 8 "Line") == Urus == Digit 1 = "Z" (Europe) Digit 2 = "P" (Italy) Digit 3 = "B" (Automobili Lamborghini Multi-purpose Passenger Vehicle) Digit 4 = Market (C=Canada, E=Europe/Rest of World, U=USA) Digit 5 = Body/Restraint: Multi-purpose Passenger Vehicle (A=Urus, B=Urus S, C=Urus Performante, D=Urus SE) All have 8 airbags (Dual Front, Fr/Rear Side, Front to Rear Side Curtain) and type 2 active seat belts with pretensioners. Digit 6 = Engine (1=4.0L (3996 cc) twin-turbo V8 641HP EA825 (DHU), 3=4.0L twin-turbo V8 657HP EA825 (DWN), 6=4.0L twin-turbo V8 612HP EA825 (DWH) + 189HP front electric motor (made by ZF) = 789HP Total) Digit 7 = Make: Z=Lamborghini Digit 8 = Line: L=Urus Digit 9 = North American VIN Check Digit. Must be digits 0-9 or letter X. Digit 10 = Model Year (eg K=2019, L=2020, etc.) Digit 11 = Plant (L=Sant'Agata Bolognese - Bologna, Italy) Digit 12 = Serial number prefix "A" (legacy value) Digits 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17 = Serial Number (clarified by digit 8 "Line") == Mid-2003 through 2010 Murcielago & through 2014 Gallardo == Digit 1 = "Z" (Europe) Digit 2 = "H" (Italy) Digit 3 = "W" (Automobili Lamborghini) Digit 4 = Model (B=Murcielago [includes Reventon], G=Gallardo) Digit 5 = Market (C=Canada, E=Europe/Rest of World, U=USA, A=Arabian Countries) Digit 6 = Body/Restraint Murcielago (1=Coupe, 2=Roadster, 3=LP640 Coupe, 4=LP640 Roadster/LP650-4 Roadster, 7=Reventon coupe, 8=LP670-4 SV Coupe, 9=Reventon Roadster) All have 2 airbags (front) and type 2 active seat belts. Digit 6 = Body/Restraint Gallardo (1=Coupe, 2=Spyder, 4=Superleggera Coupe, 5=LP560-4 Coupe or LP550-2 Coupe, 6=LP560-4 Spyder or LP550-2 Spyder, 7=LP570-4 Coupe, 8=LP570-4 Spyder Performante) All have 4 airbags (front, side) and type 2 active seat belts. Digit 7 = Mid-2003-2009 Murcielago: Engine (6=6.2L V12 572HP L537 [Murcielago], 7=6.5L V12 631HP L537A [LP 640]), 7=6.5L V12 641HP L537A [Reventon coupe]), 1=6.5L V12 661HP L537A [Non-N. American market: LP670-4 SV Coupe, Reventon roadster]) Digit 7 = 2004-2009 Gallardo: Engine (1=5.0L V10 493HP 07L0 ['04-'05 Gallardo], 2=5.0L V10 513HP 07L1 ['06-'08 Gallardo], 3=5.0 L V10 523HP 07L2 [Superleggera], 4=5.2L V10 552HP CEH [LP560-4]) Digit 7 = 2010-2014 Gallardo: Wheel Drive (A=4WD, B=2WD) Digit 7 = 2010 Murcielago: Wheel Drive (A=4WD) Digit 8 = Mid-2003-2009: Gear Type (M=6-spd. manual, N=low ratio 6-spd. manual, S=e-gear, T=low ratio e-gear) Digit 8 = 2010 Murcielago: Engine/Transmission (L=6.5L V12 641HP L537A Manual [not used], N=6.5L V12 641HP L537A e-gear [LP650-4],
G=6.5L V12 661HP L538 Manual [LP670-4 SV], H=6.5L V12 661HP L538 e-gear [LP670-4 SV]),
N=used by Reventon roadster (unknown meaning) Digit 8 = 2010-2014 Gallardo: Engine/Transmission (R=552HP Manual [LP560-4], U=552HP e-gear [LP560-4], V=542HP Manual [LP550-2],
Z=542HP e-gear [LP550-2], Y=562HP Manual [LP 570-4], J=562HP e-gear [LP 570-4]) (All 5.2L V10) Digit 9 = North American VIN Check Digit. Must be digits 0-9 or letter X. Digit 10 = Model Year (eg 3=2003, 9=2009, A=2010, E=2014, etc.) Digit 11 = Plant (L=Sant'Agata Bolognese - Bologna, Italy) Digit 12 = Serial number prefix "A" (legacy value) Digits 13, 14, 15, 16 and 17 = Serial Number (clarified by digit 4 "Model") == 2002 through Mid-2003 == Digit 1 = "Z" (Europe) Digit 2 = "A" (Italy) Digit 3 = "9" (Small manufacturer) - See digits 12->14 for WMI subcode Digit 4 = Model (B=Murcielago) Digit 5 = Body & Restraint System (C=2 door coupe with air bag system) Digit 6/7 = Engine (10=6.2L V12) Digit 8 = Market (U=USA, C=Canada, E=Europe/Rest of World) Digit 9 = North American VIN Check Digit. Must be digits 0-9 or letter X. Digit 10 = Model Year (eg 2=2002, 3=2003) I, O, Q, U, Z, and 0 are not used. Digit 11 = Plant (L=Sant'Agata Bolognese - Bologna, Italy) Digits 12, 13 and 14 = WMI Subcode "A12" = Automobili Lamborghini Digits 15, 16 and 17 = Serial Number (clarified by digit 4 "Model" and digit 10 "Model Year") == 1981-2001 == Digit 1 = "Z" (Europe) Digit 2 = "A" (Italy) Digit 3 = "9" (Small manufacturer) - See digits 12->14 for WMI subcode Digit 4 = Model (C=Countach, D=Diablo, E=Diablo GTR (race), J=Jalpa, L=LM002, R=Diablo Roadster) Digit 5 = Market (0=Europe/Rest of World (Countach, Jalpa, LM002), A=USA (Countach), B=USA (Jalpa), C=Canada, E=Europe/Rest of World (Diablo), U=USA (Diablo, LM002), A=2000MY Diablo GTR (race), etc.) Digit 6 = Body (0=Coupe, 2=SE/SV Coupe (2wd), 3=Roadster, 4=SUV, G=2000MY Diablo GTR (race) Digit 7 = Engine (0=3.5L V8, 5=5.2L V12, 7=5.7L V12 (1991-1997), 2=5.7L V12 (SE/SV Euro-spec), 1=5.7L V12 VVT (1998-99), 1=6.0L V12 VVT (2000-01), T=6.0L V12 VVT (2000MY Diablo GTR (race)) Digit 8 = Restraint System (B=Driver & Passenger Airbags, P=Passive Restraints, A=Active Restraints, R=Rollcage 2000MY Diablo GTR (race)) Digit 9 = North American VIN Check Digit. Must be digits 0-9 or letter X. Digit 10 = Model Year (eg A=1980, Y=2000, 1=2001, etc.) I, O, Q, U, Z, and 0 are not used. Digit 11 = Plant (L=Sant'Agata Bolognese - Bologna, Italy) Digits 12, 13 and 14 = WMI Subcode "A12" = Automobili Lamborghini Digits 15, 16 and 17 = Serial Number (clarified by digit 4 "Model" and digit 10 "Model Year") ==External link [http://www.gday.com/lambo/misc/vins.htm Http//vincarinfo.com]== A car info are the papers{{BookCat}}

Sonata NF 06-10, Tucson 05-09 GDI=Gasoline Direct Injection, DPI=Dual Port Injection (Direct & Port Injection), Ah=Amp-hour, kWh=Kilowatt-hour, PE=Product Enhancement  ===Check Digit (position 9) === ===0-9 or X === The check digit is used to validate a VIN so that computer systems can immediately calculate whether the VIN is valid. The digit is calculated by removing all the letters from the VIN and substituting them with their numeric counterpart. After the substitution, the numbers are multiplied against a weight factor table. The remaining 16 numbers are added together and divided by 11. The remainder of that calculation becomes the checksum, and if the remainder is 10 then the check digit is "X".

pages.title: Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Sterling Cars/VIN Codes
pages.text:
{{Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Warning}}{{clear}}

This is the [[w:Vehicle identification number|VIN]] format for [[w:Sterling (marque)|Sterling Cars]], a British brand of cars owned by Austin Rover Group, which was later renamed Rover Group. 

This does NOT include [[w:Sterling Trucks|Sterling Trucks]], an unrelated American brand of medium- and heavy-duty trucks. 

===Positions 1–3, World Manufacturer Identifier:===  
* SAX - Sterling passenger car

===Position 4-5, Model Line:===
* XS - Sterling 800 series (825, 827)

===Position 6, Trim Level:===
* 4 - S ('87-'89)
* 4 - Si ('90-'91)
* 5 - SLi ('89-'91)
* 8 - SL ('87-'91)

===Position 7, Body Style & Restraint System:===
* 3 - 4-dr. sedan w/motorized 2-point automatic seatbelts (automatic restraints)
* 4 - 4-dr. sedan w/manual seat belts (active restraints)
* 5 - 5-dr. hatchback w/manual seat belts (active restraints)
* 6 - 5-dr. hatchback w/motorized 2-point automatic seatbelts (automatic restraints)

===Position 8, Engine and Transmission:===
* A - Honda C25A 2.5L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6. 49-state emissions. Honda 5-speed manual. ('87-'88 825)
* B - Honda C25A 2.5L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6. 49-state emissions. Honda 4-speed automatic. ('87-'88 825)
* C - Honda C25A 2.5L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6. California emissions. Honda 5-speed manual. ('87-'88 825)
* D - Honda C25A 2.5L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6. California emissions. Honda 4-speed automatic. ('87-'88 825)
* G - Honda C27A 2.7L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6 w/variable intake manifold. 49-state emissions. Honda 5-speed manual. ('89-'91 827)
* H - Honda C27A 2.7L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6 w/variable intake manifold. 49-state emissions. Honda 4-speed automatic. ('89-'91 827)
* J - Honda C27A 2.7L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6 w/variable intake manifold. California emissions. Honda 5-speed manual. ('89-'91 827)
* K - Honda C27A 2.7L SOHC, 24-valve 90° V6 w/variable intake manifold. California emissions. Honda 4-speed automatic. ('89-'91 827)

===Position 9, Check Digit===
[[Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Check digit |Check digit]]

===Position 10, Model Year: ===                      
[[Vehicle Identification Numbers (VIN codes)/Model year|Model year]]

===Position 11, Production Plant:===
* M:    Cowley, England, UK

'''Positions 12–17, Serial Number'''
